login.helpText: Parent accounts are created by your school's transport office, or by accepting an invite link they sent you. Contact them if you don't have login details yet.
login.forgotPasswordSent: If that email has an account, a reset link is on its way.
login.forgotPasswordNeedsEmail: Enter your email above first, then tap "Forgot password?".

dashboard.noChildren: No children are linked to your account yet. Contact your school's transport office to have your account connected.

invite.invalidBody: It may have already been used, or it's expired. Ask your school's transport office for a new one.
invite.welcomeBody: {{schoolName}} has invited you to the parent portal for {{studentName}}.
invite.fullNameHint: Only needed if this is your first child on the portal — skip it if you already have a Rihla parent account.
invite.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. If you already have an account with this email, enter that account's password to link this child to it.
invite.successBody: {{studentName}} is now linked to your account. Signing you in…

errors.invite_already_used: This invite link has already been used.
errors.invalid_input: Please check your email and use a password of at least 8 characters.
errors.existing_account_wrong_password: An account with this email already exists, but that password is incorrect.
errors.auth_create_failed: Couldn't create your account. Please try again.
errors.profile_create_failed: Couldn't finish setting up your account. Please try again.
errors.link_failed: Your account was created, but linking your child failed. Contact your school's transport office.
errors.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts on this invite. Ask your school for a new invite link.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.tooShortError: Password must be at least 8 characters.
